title: Briefing for 2026-11-27
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-27: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: China industrial profits growth surges to a 5-month high of 20.1% in October. Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos set to lead European Central Bank. U.S. tariff-hike threats pile pressure on partners to sign trade deals. Liesman: Why Greenspan could bet on productivity — and Warsh needs to hike. Fed’s preferred inflation gauge accelerated to 3.8% in October, raising the 2027 stakes for the central bank. Even the price of toys is on the rise. How Americans are scaling back holiday plans.
global: US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC. Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US. New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat. Watch: BBC confronts German man suspected of supplying migrant gangs with small boats. Faisal Islam: Why Trump's new tariffs are less of a threat. UK to pay 'participation' fee to deliver EU deals.
philippines: Nobel Committee chair emphasizes human accountability for AI’s potential harms. Duterte’s ICC trial: How to watch and follow the proceedings. Dutch groups ask court to halt Meta smart glasses sales over privacy concerns. For a mother who lost 2 sons, Duterte’s ICC trial is a birthday gift.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
